## Is Your Feature Request Related to a Problem?

A clear and concise description of the problem or gap this request addresses.

*Example: "I couldn't find any information about bail bonds in Riverside County.
The guides focus on LA and Orange County but don't cover the Inland Empire."*

---

## Describe the Solution You'd Like

A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

*Example: "Add a section to the weekend bail guide covering Riverside County
Sheriff's Office booking process and typical processing times."*

---

## Type of Request

- [ ] New FAQ guide (new topic or question)
- [ ] County-specific information (which county: _________)
- [ ] Legal source addition or update
- [ ] Website / UI improvement
- [ ] Accessibility improvement
- [ ] Translation / language support
- [ ] Other: ___________

---

## Alternatives Considered

A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features
you've considered, and why the suggested solution is preferred.

---
